saw_lines: Labels buy attribution tools after one campaign they cannot explain, then judge each one by whether it names the winning ad.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a label looks for proof and finds none.
Your 29 ads carry no proof number, so collect one real figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 13 Nov 2026
points: None of your 29 ads shows a proof number, so a cold viewer has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one real figure, like your review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it on the creative.
All 29 ads started within the last 9 days, so none has had time to prove its hook. Keep your best one and build the next three as variations of it, changing only the first line and the closing line.
0 of 29 ads carry an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Give new buyers one reason to buy now, a first order discount or starter bundle, and open three new ads with it.
Your 29 ads use 26 different openers, so no single hook gets a clear test. Pick the two best openers, the 4 ways labels guess and the We ran 3 ads story, and build the next batch only from them.
